#### dynamic_binary

`Code dynamic_binary(Code code)`

Boxes both operands of an arithmetic, shift, or bitwise operator for
`Var.binary`, after rejecting an operand that is neither a number nor,
for `+` beside text, text. The call is returned lowered, because an
operator chain applies this rule once for each term and binding would
search the whole remaining chain each time.

Source: `src/linked-meta.x:588`

#### lambda_cells

`Code lambda_cells(Code node)`

Moves each local and parameter of the function `node` that a lambda in
its body shares by reference into a Scope cell, so the binding outlives
the call: a parameter is copied into its cell at entry, a local is
declared as its cell, and every read goes through the cell. A lifted
lambda's function moves its own. The function binds again only its
cells and the statements that hold them; its other statements are kept
as they are bound.

Source: `src/linked-meta.x:1153`

## Design notes

Generated by tools/gen-linked-meta.sh; do not edit. Bodied `meta`
functions and initialized static values from shipped source
modules appear without their `meta` markers,
so their functions and initializers execute as native code.
`Compiler.bind_linked_meta` binds an included definition to its
copy when its definition hashes agree, and a prelude component's
definition always. Public
functions with a run-time form bind to their ordinary provider's
definitions and have no copy here.
